formula: effective_score = sum(w_i * score_i) / sum(w_i); w_i = base_i * (0.5 + gate_pass_rate_i) * (elo_i / 1500)
criteria: docs/ops/DECISION-MATRIX.md: Impact 1-5 x Importance 1-5 = score 1-25; bands P0 20-25, High 15-19, Medium 9-14, Backlog <=8
seed_note: Initial weights are neutral defaults (gate_pass_rate 0.5, elo 1500). The live state is the newest JSON comment on the 'Delphi panel weights ledger' issue; this file is only the cold-start default.

cycle.expectation_format: per-candidate expected rank + expected weighted score per source class, recorded before implementation; brief-supplied human expectations take precedence for their class
cycle.implementation: parallel per-proposal implementations; tests run per individual proposal; their results are the round-2 evidence base
cycle.evidence_equalization: the round-2 evidence set is identical for every voter; its sha256 is stamped on the round-2 receipt and required on every round-2 ballot
cycle.calibration: round-2 outcome vs the recorded input expectations; deltas with the evidence that moved them; the feed for the weights (#1489) and outcome (#1487) ledgers
cycle.not_run_rule: a stage that cannot execute is recorded specified_not_run in the cycle record - never dropped, never fabricated

cross_vote.class_rule: Classes are tallied and reported separately, never merged (DEBATE protocol). DRIVER_SYNTHESIS is not a ballot. A class with no ballots is reported as zero.
cross_vote.weights_source: Newest JSON state on the Delphi panel weights ledger issue (#1489); this file's role values are cold-start defaults.
cross_vote.ballot_record: Ranked outcome is appended to the outcome ledger (#1487) as a delphi-generation-ballot v1 JSON comment, with the full receipt in the pass record.
